data.title: Next.js
data.tagline: A React framework for building full websites and web applications
data.learningOutcome: You can connect `/posts` to `app/posts/page.tsx` in an App Router project and tell whether data is prepared before or after the browser receives the page.
data.description: When someone opens `/products/42`, Next.js can find that product page and fetch product data on the server before showing it. It does not automatically provide a product database or permission system.

learning.assumes: You know a URL such as /posts can open a page.
learning.outcome: You can connect `/posts` to `app/posts/page.tsx` in an App Router project and tell whether data is prepared before or after the browser receives the page.

explanation.title: The URL maps to a file
explanation.text: In the App Router, `/posts` maps to `app/posts/page.tsx`.

explanation.title: The server prepares content for the browser
explanation.text: The page can fetch an article list and prepare HTML on the server before sending it to the browser, reducing white-screen wait times.

explanation.title: Mark interactive components with 'use client'
explanation.text: Components run on the server by default. Those requiring user interaction (onClick, useState) must have 'use client' at the top. The common 'useState only works in Client Components' error means this directive is missing.

data.boundary: One Next.js project can contain server and browser code, and you must explicitly mark browser code with 'use client'. Secrets must stay on the server side and never be sent to the browser.

lessonPractice.title: A React content site needs a URL per article, search-readable pages, and consistent page structure. What should Next.js own?

options.label: Organize routing, page rendering, and data loading while storage and permissions remain explicit
options.feedback: Next.js extends React with site structure and rendering, but cannot invent the project's business data or authorization.

options.label: Install Next.js and receive an article database, login permissions, and admin workflow automatically
options.feedback: The framework provides building capabilities, not the project's data model, account rules, or operations.

options.label: Migrate the entire project to Next.js whenever one React button appears
options.feedback: One component does not require a full-site framework; the choice depends on routing, rendering, and deployment.

data.agentPrompt: Use Next.js for article routes, page metadata, and data loading while reusing current React components. Do not assume automatic storage or permissions; list and verify the remaining article storage, login, and deployment work.
